title: Courtesy Late-Fee Waiver Allowances by Ridgeline Consumer Credit Tier
content:
The courtesy late-fee waiver figures differ by Ridgeline Consumer Credit tier as follows.

| | Card Classic | Card Preferred | Card Premier | Project Loan 66 | Project Loan 78 | Project Loan 84 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Courtesy waivers allowed in any rolling 12-month window | 1 | 1 | 2 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Full months open before a waiver can be granted | 12 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Calendar days after the late fee posts within which a waiver may be requested | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |

- *Waivers per 12 months* is the number of courtesy late-fee waivers the account may receive in any rolling 12-month window: two on Card Premier, one on every other tier.
- *Months open* is the number of full months the account must have been open: 12 on Card Classic, 6 on every other tier.
- *Request window* is the number of calendar days after a late fee posts during which a courtesy waiver may be requested: 60 on every tier.

Hypothetical contrast: a Card Classic account open 8 full months has not reached its tier's months-open figure, while a Card Preferred account open the same 8 months has.
